messages:
ops-announce: Heads-up: scheduled control-plane certificate rotation for us-east1 on 2026-04-10 04:00-05:00 UTC. We'll rotate certs on control-plane nodes and restart auth proxies. Expected impact: brief auth errors for webhook callbacks and SDK token refreshes. Oncall for this window: @jess. Please review the runbook and customer notice.
jess: ack. I'll take the window. Thanks for moving it. Please confirm rollback steps and thresholds.
carla-iam: Confirmed. Rollback trigger is sustained auth_4xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m or >1.0% for any 1m spike. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/controlplane-cert-rotation
support-lynn: I'll draft customer copy and an FAQ about webhook retry behavior.
oncall-bot: Maintenance scheduled: us-east1 control-plane cert rotation start=3412363200 end=3412366800. Pager rotation unchanged.
--- (rotation starts) ---
incident-bot: Alert: elevated 401 rate observed in us-east1 at 3412363505. Metric: auth_4xx_rate = 2.1% (baseline <0.2%).
jess: ack, investigating. Pausing certificate rollout to remaining nodes. Rolling back last puppet change on cp-node-07.
ops-sre: quick logs:
```
[3412363510] cp-node-07 auth-proxy: TLS handshake alert: bad_certificate
[3412363512] token-service: token-validate error: signature mismatch for cert-id \"2026-04-10-rot\"
```
ops-sre: looks like new cert chain wasn't propagated to token-service replicas. Holding rollout.
jess: mitigation plan: 1) Stop rotation. 2) Re-provision token-service with old cert chain. 3) Re-try rotation after propagation. Executing step 2 now.
support-lynn: Posted initial customer status: "We're performing scheduled maintenance in us-east1. We observed transient authentication errors for some webhook callbacks while we paused the rotation. We're rolling back a cert change and expect normal service shortly. No data loss."
ops-sre: ran commands to reload token-service certs on replicas:
```
ssh ops@token-replica-*.use1
sudo cp /etc/certs/old-chain.pem /etc/token-service/certs/chain.pem
sudo systemctl restart token-service
```
ops-sre: replicas reloaded, auth_4xx_rate dropping: 2.1% -> 0.25% -> 0.05% over 6m.
jess: auth errors cleared. Keeping pause for 10m to verify. Will only continue rotation with explicit approval.
status-page-bot: Public update posted at 3412364100: "Update: brief authentication errors detected during our control-plane maintenance in us-east1. We rolled back a cert change and service has recovered. We will post a final update when maintenance completes."
--- (verification complete, rotation resumes) ---
incident-bot: No new alerts. Monitoring fine.
support-lynn: Sending follow-up customer note: "We detected and mitigated transient auth errors during the maintenance. If you saw webhook retries, they should now have retried successfully. If you continue to see issues, please contact support with your webhook ID."
jess: rotation resumed with additional propagation checks. Completed final nodes at 3412368600.
ops-announce: Maintenance complete: control-plane cert rotation finished in us-east1 at 3412368600. Summary: brief auth 401 spike during rollout due to cert propagation mismatch; mitigated by rolling back to prior cert chain and reloading token-service replicas, then reapplying rotation after propagation checks. Action items: add cert-propagation verification step to runbook, improve rollout checklist, and add an automated check to verify token-service replicas after cert changes. Assign postmortem to jess/ops-sre/support-lynn. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:"
